purpose: Base visual foundation for every studio prototype. Provides the token contract, typography, elevation, and theme CSS that the selected visual pack must materialize into output.
whenToUse: Always include before applying any domain visual pack
Use when the prototype needs a real token layer instead of ad-hoc styling
Use when Reasoning or Analytics must prove which style files were connected
forbiddenPatterns: raw inline palette definitions without the foundation token layer
styling a prototype without a linked theme css file
description: Base design tokens for the visual bank. Platform-agnostic CSS custom properties and JSON specs.

files.tokens.css: CSS custom properties — base neutral scale

usage: Import tokens.css in any project root. Override with a theme CSS file on :root or [data-theme].
